decisions.decision: SourceOrigin/DestinationOrigin as new PolicyCondition variants (not nested like AppField)
decisions.rationale: Follows exact pattern of SourceApplication/DestinationApplication from Phase 26. Origins are simple string comparisons.

decisions.decision: source_origin = page URL from Chrome request; destination_origin = None
decisions.rationale: Chrome Content Analysis API v1 only provides one URL. True source-origin tracking deferred to v0.9.0+ native extension.

decisions.decision: Operators: eq, ne, contains for origin conditions
decisions.rationale: Same operator set as ImagePath and Aumid. contains enables partial domain matching.
